# PNEUMA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 11
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic/Functional)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 17 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 11

---

**11:1** When Mary finished speaking, she went quiet. That was as much as the Savior had told her.

**11:2** But Andrew spoke up and addressed the group: "What do the rest of you make of what she said? Speaking for myself, I don't believe the Savior actually said any of this. These teachings sound completely foreign to me."

---

*Translator's Note (PNEUMA):* "Sound completely foreign" renders *xenon dogmata* in natural speech. Andrew's challenge is an honest theological objection — he genuinely cannot reconcile these ideas with what he knows. PNEUMA renders his doubt sympathetically.
